name: OrchardBlockManager
tagline: The block register for orchards and vineyards – varieties, rootstocks, trees, tasks and replants in one app.
description: A complete perennial-crop block register for Power Apps and Power Pages: dashboard KPIs, a sortable and groupable register with bulk actions, a pruning/thinning task board, a replant timeline driven by economic life, and a variety × rootstock mix – with demo data, validation, lifecycle rules, undo and Power Fx events.
features: Lifecycle rules Young → Productive → Replant planned → Grubbed out → Fallow
Bulk task, status and manager updates
Acres or hectares, custom labels and colours
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: OrchardBlockManager data-set + OrchardBlockManagerPortal field)
